content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the incorrect usage of the XFAIL macro in the `close_range_cloexec` test after the removal of XFAIL in favor of SKIP in the self-tests framework. The test was still using XFAIL to handle conditions where the test should be skipped, leading to inconsistencies and potential failures in the test suite. The patch corrected this by replacing XFAIL with SKIP, ensuring that the test behaves as intended when certain conditions are not met.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: - XFAIL(return, "Skipping test since /dev/null does not exist");
